mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the gland pathway to the light-linked clock was most worthwhile: the result explained the indirect route and how light can suppress the nighttime melatonin signal.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempts to connect the clock directly to the nerve route and the gland directly to the body were frustrating because the required order was unclear.

surprise.text: The pineal nerve route loops through the spinal cord and a nerve cluster in the neck. I had expected a more direct connection within the brain.

arbitrary.text: The required assembly order felt somewhat arbitrary until inspection revealed that the connected gland could join the clock. The completed pathway then explained why the indirect route matters.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it explored another surprising body connection. The explanation of light and melatonin was engaging, though the failed attempts made the assembly order less clear.
